items.title: "Wooden Joe" Nicholas Interview, 1956-11-12
items.q: I was playing with Joe Alvarez.

ctx.x: One of your brothers. Brother or sister? Brother. That's right. He'd be your brother Charles, his name was Nicholas. What instrument did you take up first?

Mm-hmm . I guess I put all the rest down. Well I could play them. I never forget them. I could play them. And that's why I got a carnet. I didn't know. I was playing climbing that's good. Playing with Joe Alvarez. I was playing with Joe Alvarez. I was playing with Joe Alvarez. I was watching him while he was playing with Joe Alvarez. He was kind of lazy. He didn't like to play too much. He said, I dropped him. Joe dropped him. I said, well, I said, just four pieces, just three. Then I said, well, I don't know. I…
Who else was in the band when Oliver was there at Abedee's? Who else? Do you remember? Was it Richard M Jones?
